name: Binh Thuy ancient house
kicker: The Dương family's five-bay house of 1870
summary: Five-bay house of 1870 mixing Eastern and French design: walk its rooms and garden, a film set for The Lover. The Dương family built it, and it became a national architectural monument in 2009. Inside are French-style woven cloth, white lanterns, and Ming and Qing teacups. Go between 08:00 and 16:00, and add Đình Bình Thủy nearby.
getThere: By taxi or motorbike from Ninh Kiều
heroCaption: The house front, the yard, and the roof at Bình Thủy

notice.title: The communal house is a separate visit
notice.body: Đình Bình Thủy is in the same district with its own gate. Ask at the door before you assume one fee covers both.

body: The Dương family built the house at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa in 1870, and it still stands almost intact. It mixes Eastern and Western design, with building materials ordered from France. It was named a national architectural and artistic monument in 2009.
Look for the Louis XV-style woven cloth, the white lanterns, and the teacups from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Films shot here include The Lover.

figures.caption: The side yard and the roof of the Bình Thủy house
figures.alt: Side yard and tiled roof of the Binh Thuy ancient house in Can Tho

gettingThere: The house is at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa in Bình Thủy. Go by taxi or motorbike from Ninh Kiều, and pair it with Đình Bình Thủy in the same district.
closed: No weekly closing day is published.
admissionNote: 20,000 to 50,000 VND. Confirm the band at the door.
